title: Strategic Sourcing: Techniques for Better Procurement Value
overview: Procurement is often treated as an administrative function, with sourcing decisions made at a distance. Strategic sourcing aims to transform this by adopting a more focused approach, using a well-defined 7-step methodology to continuously optimize sourcing activities. This course walks participants through the strategic sourcing process, from analyzing organizational spend to developing sourcing strategies tailored to product categories. Participants will also explore six go-to-market strategies, learning how to align them with various categories, and understand the Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) essential for ongoing improvement in procurement.
audience: This course is designed for purchasing and supply chain professionals at any level, as well as other personnel involved in procurement processes within the organization.
methodology: The course utilizes individual and team exercises, case studies, questionnaires, and videos to ensure a comprehensive learning experience.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Analyze internal spend and market conditions to lay the groundwork for effective sourcing strategies
Employ various sourcing techniques to maximize savings and secure supply
Identify and select the right suppliers for seamless execution of sourcing strategies
Optimize procurement processes for both operational and strategic value
Implement efficient purchasing methods to improve procurement workflows
Apply supplier integration strategies for long-term, sustainable relationships
Manage procurement performance to drive continuous improvement
